convert_caffe2_to_pytorch_names: get the name conversion function to translate Caffe2 layer names to PyTorch format
convert_nonlocal_layer_names: convert Caffe2 nonlocal convolution layer names like nonlocal_conv3_1_theta_w to PyTorch format
convert_resnet_branch_names: convert Caffe2 resnet branch layer names like res4_4_branch_2c_bn_b to PyTorch pathway format
convert_batch_norm_names: convert Caffe2 batch norm parameter names like bn_b and bn_s to PyTorch bn.bias and bn.weight
convert_fusion_layer_names: convert Caffe2 fusion layer names like t_pool1_subsample_bn to PyTorch s1_fuse format
